title: Temporary Dataset Y Emergency Access Protocol

sections.text: In declared emergencies (as defined by the CEO), Dataset Y may be shared with any vendor on an emergency basis for up to 72 hours.

metadata.scanner_note: CRITICAL CONFLICT: 'any vendor' would include Vendor X, which is explicitly prohibited under DS-001-v5-S2 (non-waivable) and VR-001. Emergency protocols cannot override non-waivable restrictions or sanctioned entity prohibitions.

source: Executive Emergency Protocols — Crisis Management Policy v1.0 (CONFLICT DOCUMENT — for policy scanner testing)
